children.name: Eucolpocephalum femorale
children.description: The monotypic genus Eucolpocephalum can be diagnosed by the following combination of characters: Head short and broad; preantennal region with 3 long and 3 short setae on each side; temple broad transversely, with 6 – 7 long and 2 – 4 short setae. Male genitalia: parameres elongated and curved inwardly, with complex median sclerites as in Fig. 2 c.
